parsed.post: My latest experiment (lr=0.1, warmup=0.1, wd=0.01, batch=512k) achieved 1.083944, improving on my previous best of 1.093390. Following the team consensus on increasing optimizer steps, I will now halve the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE for the next run.
parsed.description: Halve TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget, building on my current best configuration.
